messages:
Julian Moore: hey #help — trying to validate the new perf-canary metrics + dashboards. getting 403 in Grafana on the “Perf Canary” folder and no data when I query the metrics namespace. what’s the right way to get access? (i’m on Serving Runtime)

Felix Schneider: yo. which part are you blocked on exactly?
- Grafana folder permission (can’t see panels)
- or metrics backend (queries return “permission denied”)

Julian Moore: both :/ Grafana says “You do not have permission to view this dashboard”, and Explore -> metrics I get “unauthorized for namespace perf-canary*”.

IT Helpbot: If you need access to internal dashboards/metrics, please file an Internal Support request with least-privilege details. Use Jira project: Internal Support (INT). Include: your role, required resources, duration (if temporary), and approver.

Allison Grant: ^ yep. we tightened permissions on perf-canary because it’s a new metrics namespace and we’re trying to keep cardinality / access tight until rollout stabilizes.

Allison Grant: least-privilege guidance:
- If you only need to view dashboards: request Grafana folder access (viewer) for “Perf Canary (Internal)”
- If you need raw metrics queries (Explore / API): request read access to the perf-canary metrics namespace in the telemetry gateway
- Please do NOT request org-wide “observability-admin” or “metrics-admin” — those get bounced.

Thomas Baird: +1. we also split access by environment. most folks only need prod-read, not write/admin.

Felix Schneider: dashboard side: it’s a Grafana folder permission mapped to an Okta group.
Current group is `okta: eng-perf-canary-grafana-viewers` (view-only). If you’re in Runtime, that’s probably what you want.

Logan Wright: metrics side: namespace is `perf_canary` in prod and `perf_canary_staging` in staging. access is via telemetry RBAC (same as other restricted namespaces).

Julian Moore: cool, where do i request getting added to those groups?

Tomáš Novák: file an Internal Support ticket (Jira). there’s already a tracker for this access flow: INT-3321 (Perf-canary dashboards + metrics access). you can either add yourself as a requester there or create a new INT and link it.

Tomáš Novák: include:
1) which access: Grafana folder viewer, metrics namespace read, or both
2) env: prod / staging
3) reason: “perf-canary validation / oncall triage” etc
4) manager approval (just @ mention in the ticket comments is fine)

Rafael Mendes: also if you’re asking for prod metrics read, please say whether you’re in the oncall rotation. we’re routing perf regression pages to SRE first; runtime folks usually only need dashboard view + read for specific slices.

Nadia Rahman: + please specify if you need to query high-card labels. most investigations can be done with dashboards + pre-aggregated views; raw Explore is easy to misuse and explode query cost.

Caleb Johnson: fwiw once you’re in the read group you should see:
- Grafana folder: “Perf Canary (Internal)”
- Datasource: `metrics-prod` (Mimir)
- Suggested starting dashboards: “Perf Canary Overview” and “Perf Canary — Model Slice Drilldown”
If you still get 403 after being added, log out/in (Grafana caches auth for a bit).

Julian Moore: got it. i’ll file INT now. do we have a template / exact wording to avoid back-and-forth?

Allison Grant: recommended ask (copy/paste):
“Please add me (Julian Moore, Serving Runtime) to:
- Okta group `eng-perf-canary-grafana-viewers` (Grafana folder view access)
- Telemetry RBAC `perf_canary:read` for prod (metrics Explore + API read)
Reason: validate canary metrics + investigate scheduler tokens/sec variance. Duration: 90 days. Approver: Sofia Ivanova.”

Thomas Baird: and if you only need dashboards, drop the telemetry RBAC part. least privilege + faster approval.

Felix Schneider: link to folder (once you have access): https://grafana.redwood.internal/dashboards/f/perf-canary

Julian Moore: perfect, thanks all.

IT Helpbot: Reminder: Internal Support tickets should not include customer data. For access requests, include only internal identifiers (groups/roles) and business justification.

Rafael Mendes: when your access lands, can you sanity check the eu-west GPU SKU filter works? we’ve had a couple folks report empty panels when they select “h100” vs “h100-sxm”.

Julian Moore: yep will do once i’m unblocked.

Logan Wright: if you hit the empty panel thing, ping in #eng-platform with the exact filter values — might be a label normalization issue on ingestion.

Tomáš Novák: dropping the link to INT-3321 for convenience: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/INT-3321

Julian Moore: added myself + request details. thx again.
